source_snapshot.items: All SSD NVMe LED Check - Present
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert an NVMe SSD into each backplane slot and check that the Present LED works normally; collect results/photos and inspect system logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check the LED function defined by the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL assigns visual confirmation to the operator and suggests controller/BMC indicator commands plus lsblk, but its undocumented raw IPMI example can alter an unrelated state and does not prove a physical Present LED.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED with HIGH physical/storage/control risk; exact SSD-slot map, Present LED definition, qualified operator, supported hot-swap/data procedure, documented vendor query and complete visual/system evidence are required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly retains manual observation but conflates Present with a controllable locate indicator and proposes insecure SSH plus undocumented raw bytes.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates the authoritative physical Present indication from read-only enumeration and permits only documented vendor assistance.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row80 owns insertion/removal mechanics; row82 owns Access/Busy behavior under I/O; neither substitutes for this row's passive presence indication.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The physical LED observation remains authoritative and must be correlated to stable SSD, slot and controller identities without assuming generic color or timing.

original_test_intent: Verify that inserting each approved NVMe SSD into its mapped backplane slot produces the platform-specified Present LED state, color and timing without unexpected storage or management errors.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts each identity-locked SSD using the approved hot-swap or powered-off service procedure and photographs the physical Present LED while the agent collects complete read-only slot, drive, controller, health and log evidence.
manual_activity: User approves the SSD/slot/LED/service matrix; qualified operator inserts each SSD and records the physical Present LED; agent only collects identity-locked read-only evidence.
required_inputs: SSD serial/NVMe ID to slot/backplane/controller mapping
Platform Present LED meaning, color, state and assertion timing
Supported hot-swap or powered-off insertion and ESD procedure
Qualified operator, secure access, OOB/console and evidence location
safety_requirements: Verify the exact SSD and slot plus hot-swap support before insertion
Quiesce affected I/O and protect mounted/RAID data as approved
Do not clear pre-existing dmesg, syslog or SEL evidence
Stop on resistance, wrong identity, enumeration mismatch, RAID/filesystem/kernel/thermal/SEL error or access loss
Never issue undocumented raw IPMI bytes or treat locate/query output as visual proof
agent_execution_scope: Capture stable pre/post SSD-slot enumeration, controller, RAID, mount, health and complete logs
Correlate operator timestamped photo to the intended slot and insertion event
Run only an explicitly documented read-only vendor query when approved
Do not insert hardware, drive a generic LED command, rebuild/recover automatically or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the identity, LED specification, service/data and recovery matrix
Provide a qualified operator and decide whether any vendor query is valid
Review the physical and system evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable for enumeration, but insecure SSH, undocumented raw IPMI and locate-style control do not establish the physical Present LED state and may change unintended platform state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only lsblk/NVMe/PCI/controller/RAID/mount/health and complete log capture around each operator insertion; add a vendor-documented read-only LED-status query only when the platform specification maps it to the same Present LED.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, backplane Present LED observation and the source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate a qualified operator's timestamped Present LED observation with stable drive-slot enumeration and complete health/log evidence for every approved slot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines authoritative identity, service safety and auditable evidence while rejecting generic raw/locate commands as proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation assists identity and health checks but does not replace the physical Present LED observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: LED semantics are platform-specific, device names can reorder and a management query may address a different indicator; the approved specification and physical photo are authoritative.

project_override_considerations: If the backplane is not hot-swap capable, insertion must occur powered off and the observation must cover the approved power-on sequence; no generic NVMe or IPMI LED assumption applies.
expected_evidence: Operator/date, service method and timestamped per-slot photos
Complete pre/post stable-ID enumeration and controller/RAID/mount/health state
Documented vendor read-only query and mapping when approved
Final population/restoration record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree that NVMe Present LED behavior requires physical observation; GPT V2 corrects unsafe and non-equivalent command assumptions without changing the source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits normal platform specification, operator, storage-safety and recovery inputs; the purpose and static review are determinable.

review_improvement: Separates passive Present indication from locate/control behavior and binds every physical observation to stable SSD-slot identity and complete storage evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Present LED is a physical platform output triggered by device presence, not necessarily by a software-controllable locate function. Enumeration can confirm that a controller discovered the SSD but cannot prove the LED's color, state or timing, so the system specification, operator photo and identity-locked controller evidence must agree.
